message: So there I was, in the middle of a cozy Friday night, when the lights suddenly flickered and went out. My first thought? "Well, this is why I keep a flashlight on every level of my house!" I grabbed my trusty lantern, lit it up, and settled in for an impromptu game night with the family, powered by our fully charged power banks. Turns out, being gloriously over-prepared can turn a blackout into a fun memory! What’s your go-to trick for staying comfortable when the lights go out? 😊
